instruction: A candid documentary wide shot captures an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet, white walls, and radiators. On the left, the man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) steps forward, placing his right hand on the shoulder of the woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2), who stands on the right facing him. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lights, casting soft shadows on the red floor. The camera is positioned at eye level, capturing both subjects in full-body view.
